---
title: "Before You Arrive"
---

The afternoon sessions are hands-on, so please arrive with a working
coding agent you can drive from your own laptop.

## 1. Sign up for a coding agent

Pick one (any will work for the workshop):

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) — CLI and IDE agent from
  Anthropic
- [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot) — includes an
  agent mode in VS Code and a CLI
- [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) — Google's agent-first
  development platform
- [Codex](https://openai.com/codex/) — OpenAI's coding agent

Most offer free tiers or trials; a paid tier will give you more headroom
for the afternoon deep dives.

## 2. Verify it works

Before the workshop, confirm that you can:

1. Open a terminal (or IDE) and start your agent
2. Point it at a small project or empty directory
3. Ask it to make a change and see the result

If you can do that, you're ready.

## 3. Bring

- A laptop with your agent installed and authenticated
- A GitHub account
- Ideas! The afternoon includes deep dives on projects *you* care
  about — a package you maintain, a workflow you want to automate, an
  analysis you want to scaffold.

::: {.callout-note}
Questions or trouble getting set up? Open an issue on the
[workshop repository](https://github.com/Bioconductor/agentic-ai-workshop-2026-boston/issues)
and we'll help before the day.
:::
